 who you are 
To make sure that everything in the warehouse runs smoothly, you meet the following requirements: - You are at least 18 years old, due to working hours; - You speak Dutch or English, for safety reasons; - You are available for at least 2 days a week; - You are physically capable of lifting crates up to 20 kg; - You have your own means of transportation to get to Kuehne + Nagel in Zwolle. 
 what will you do 
Always wondered what happens to all those deposit products from the supermarkets? As a warehouse worker you will find it out! You will be doing all kinds of work! All products coming back from the supermarkets must first be unloaded from all the trucks. Think about carts, crates, paper, and plastic! After the trucks have been unloaded, everything has to be sorted throughout the warehouse. Each product has its own place. ♻
